root_cause: The Radios component only updates conditional visibility on click events, not on keyboard-driven changes (arrow keys) that alter the checked state of radios sharing the same name, causing conditionals to remain visible when a different radio is selected via keyboard.
repair_strategy: Add a change event listener to each Radios instance that invokes the same update logic as the click handler, ensuring that any change to a radio's checked state (including via keyboard) properly shows or hides its associated conditional content.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can navigate among radio options using arrow keys and see dependent fields appear/disappear correctly, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard, 2.4.3 Focus Order, and 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.
functional_risks: Both click and change events may fire for the same interaction, but setAttributes is idempotent so impact is minimal.
Ensuring the change listener does not affect non-radio elements within the module.
verification_requirements: Verify that arrow key navigation between email, text, and none options correctly shows/hides the email address and mobile number fields.
Verify that clicking radios with mouse continues to work as before.
Verify that the form's reflected value matches the selected radio after keyboard interaction.
Ensure no regression in existing automated tests for the radios component.
